items.title: ‘Everybody tells me how I can keep working. My answer begins with ‘F’ and ends with ‘off’: Mike Leigh on 55 years of films – and why he’s just made his last
items.summary: The acclaimed director has announced his latest film Tender Loving Care will be his last. He talks about coming to terms with a life-changing condition and how he would have loved to have made a big budget modern-day movie Mike Leigh and his partner, the actor Marion Bailey, were knocking around at home last Christmas, looking for a good film to watch and constantly coming up short. Finally, Leigh had a brilliant idea. Why not put on Topsy-Turvy, his 1999 costume romp about the making of The Mikado? Problem solved, perfect choice. “It’s not like a habit,” he says hurriedly. “I don’t sit there watching my films every night like Gloria Swanson in Sunset Boulevard. items.title: Threat from China looms large over Taiwan’s local elections
items.summary: Taiwanese officials raise alarm over interference by China in elections that will shape fortunes of ruling party Taiwanese voters go to the polls on Saturday in closely watched local elections that will shape the fortunes of the ruling Democratic Progressive party (DPP) as it navigates an increasingly precarious set of relationships on the global stage. Saturday’s vote will choose mayors, council members and other local leaders across 22 districts. Unlike the presidential elections, in which foreign policy is often a key issue, the local elections, held every four years , are largely focused on bread-and-butter issues such as housing affordability and wealth distribution.
